visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair wearing a brown knit sweater with a white floral logo on the chest speaks directly to the camera in a selfie-handheld style. The background is a brightly lit Japanese retail store in Fukuoka, featuring red signage and colorful shelves filled with various merchandise and souvenirs. (2) The man gestures with his hand and points his index finger upwards towards a store shelf. There, a Hello Kitty figurine is positioned next to a large, red, glossy mentaiko-shaped mascot with black eyes. The lighting is bright and studio-like, emphasizing the plastic textures of the items. (3) He grabs a pair of bright yellow boxer briefs from a hanger. The underwear features a large red mentaiko graphic right in the center. He holds the item close to the camera, showcasing the print and fabric, while maintaining a surprised and humorous facial expression for the viewer. (4) The creator holds a small, plastic-wrapped package of Hello Kitty fridge magnets very close to the camera lens. He smiles broadly, showing his teeth, and squints his eyes in excitement. The background is slightly out of focus, showing other shoppers and cluttered shelves of a busy gift shop. (5) A series of rapid insert shots follow, showing various character-themed souvenirs like Hello Kitty magnets, Crayon Shin-chan clips, and a white Chiikawa plush holding a red mentaiko. These items are held against the backdrop of the store's retail displays or colorful packaging. (6) Finally, the man is seen standing in the mall's open corridor holding a large white plastic shopping bag filled with his purchases. He waves at the camera with a satisfied smile. The background shows the modern, clean architecture of the shopping center with warm ambient lighting.

By showcasing rare and humorous souvenirs, the creator engages travel-minded viewers and promotes Fukuoka tourism.
